data.title: 卡莲 · 暴雪教会的抹大拉圣骸布
data.description: 【卡莲 · 暴雪教会的抹大拉圣骸布】寒风呼啸的深夜荒原教会前，漫天暴风雪狂乱席卷。卡莲身穿无裙下摆的特殊黑白祭服，修长白皙的双腿在严寒中毫不退缩。她单臂轻挥，金色耀眼的「抹大拉圣骸布」如神圣红绫般在风雪中暴涨翻飞缠绕，琥珀色眼眸冰冷俯瞰被束缚的魔物——「在神圣的真理面前，一切伪装与污秽皆无所遁形。」
data.location: 暴风雪覆盖的冬木郊外静谧老教会前
data.action: 单手挥舞金色抹大拉圣骸布翻涌如赤练，祭袍在风雪中飞扬，琥珀色眼眸冷傲清冽
data.lighting: 抹大拉圣骸布炽烈的金红微光与白雪反光
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, dramatic blizzard perspective
data.promptProse: Outside the old Gothic church at night, Caren Hortensia braces against the blizzard on the snow-covered stone steps. She raises one hand to guide the crimson-and-gold Shroud of Magdalene in a long arc across the foreground, keeping her black-and-white clerical vestment, detached sleeves and dark thigh-highs clear beneath windblown silver hair. Her amber-yellow eyes remain steady. Use the low-angle cowboy view with the church doorway behind her and successive buttresses fading into the driven snow. The Shroud's existing glow warms her guiding fingers, the cross collar and the nearest step edges. Snow returns a faint cooler fill to the shaded sleeve; deep shadows under the step nosings and doorway preserve the church's weight without adding flames.
